Frequently Asked Questions

What is the actual GPU TGP wattage of ASUS TUF Gaming A15 (FA506NC)?

The ASUS TUF Gaming A15 (FA506NC) features a 75W (60W + 15W Dynamic Boost) rating for its NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 4GB GDDR6. This ensures stable framerates without thermal throttling under sustained gaming loads.

Can I upgrade the RAM and SSD on this laptop?

Yes! It has 2x SO-DIMM slots (Expandable up to 32GB) and 2x M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 slots. You can easily drop in an additional 16GB RAM stick or high-speed Gen4 NVMe SSD at home without voiding warranty.

Is this laptop recommended for programming, coding, and college?

ASUS TUF Gaming A15 (FA506NC) scores 9.0/10 for software engineering. Its AMD Ryzen 5 7535HS (6 Cores, 12 Threads, up to 4.55 GHz) easily handles Docker, multiple IDEs, compiling code, and virtual machines.
